description: Official Langfuse documentation for agent and LLM evaluation, datasets, experiments, evaluators, scores, tracing, and prompt management.
rules: For evaluation tasks, first retrieve current docs from content/docs/evaluation/experiments, evaluation-methods, and scores; use content/docs/api-and-data-platform for API access.
Before writing evaluation code, retrieve the current datasets, experiments, evaluator, or scoring page and follow its SDK/API signatures and linked reference. Do not rely on remembered APIs.
Match examples to the user's installed SDK major version and language. Use upgrade-path pages only for migrations; do not mix legacy and current SDK examples.
Use current reference documentation for API signatures and cookbooks for implementation examples. Prefer these sources over historical blog posts and changelogs.
Distinguish SDK experiment evaluators, Langfuse-hosted evaluators, and externally computed scores; follow the documentation for the requested execution model.
